prs.location:
Alto Vetro is on the west side of Grand Canal Dock, a popular area for the arts and enterprise, making the Bord Gais Energy Theatre, 3Arena and a host of international companies from Google to Accenture part of your neighbourhood. 

If you want to stay local, the Art of Coffee is in the building. The celebrated Marker Hotel is 500 metres away, affording you a choice of spa treatments, fine food and tempting cocktails. While Il Valentino is the quintessential Italian bakery and café on Grand Canal Harbour, tempting every sense.

Getting around the city is easy in this connected location with Grand Canal Dock Dart station only five minutes away and Dublinbikes at your door. The best of Dublin’s activities await you from shopping on Grafton Street to coastal walks along Sandymount Strand.

description:
Newly furnished 2 bed apartment. Alto Vetro is one of Dublin City’s most exclusive waterside addresses, this iconic awarding winning, 16 storey glazed tower is a recognisable feature of the city’s Skyline. 

The contemporary designed living accommodation benefits from floor to ceiling windows providing stunning panoramic views of the City and the Greater Grand Canal area.
 
The area is a popular choice for anyone seeking the best of city living. You are walking distance to Trinity college, The Bord Gais Theatre, Aviva Stadium, O2 Arena and Grafton street which is regarded as Dublin’s premier shopping district. 

In the immediate vicinity there are several International HQ’s such as Google, Facebook, Accenture, Twitter and numerous leading law firms. 

The location of Alto Vetro is at the centre of Dublin’s transport network. The area is well served by numerous public transport nodes such as the DART (Grand Canal Dart station a 5-minute walk away), Various Dublin bus routes and The City bike docking station is located across the road. 

The building has a dedicated Property manager and maintenance team and benefits from a 24-hour emergency line and CCTV monitoring.
